origin: Vectan reloading catalogue (Nobel Sport), rifle tables (read by OCR, tools/loaddata/vectan_extract.py)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 77 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (23 cartridges), velocity error 6.5 % rms. Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the maker states single-base), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data. The catalogue gives no test barrel and no pressures: a barrel of 600 mm was assumed (a 100 mm shorter barrel gives a burn rate about 10 % higher), so the burn rate is only as good as that assumption. Bullet lengths are estimated from mass, diameter and type. Fewer data or a poorer fit than most other records: use with more caution.
